resolution: No new change required. origin/main already contains merged commit 71cffcd ('review-fix: audit batch - API-P2-002 pagination, API-P2-004 CSR validation', authored in the prior remediation batch) which implements keyset pagination: Store.list_sensors_page fetches limit+1 rows ordered by sensor_id and returns nextCursor only when another page exists, and ControlPlaneService.h_list_sensors reads/validates the cursor query parameter, calls list_sensors_page(state, limit, cursor), and emits body['nextCursor'] when present. The contract at api/openapi/falcon-edge-v1.yaml already documents the cursor query parameter on /sensors and SensorPage.nextCursor. Reproduction: a >500 sensor fixture returns page1 rows=500 nextCursor='sensor-0499' and a final page rows=1 nextCursor=None. API-P2-001 is closed on origin/main. No branch, commit or draft PR was created for PS-013 to avoid a no-op PR (guardrail).
